text.en:
1. (1)  Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Koperasi (Majlis Perundingan Koperasi Kebangsaan) (Pindaan) (No. 2) 2022.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 September 2022.

Pindaan peraturan 6

2. Peraturan-Peraturan Koperasi (Majlis Perundingan  Koperasi Kebangsaan) 2010
[P.U. (A) 130/2010] dipinda dalam teks  bahasa Inggeris, dalam peraturan 6,
dengan menggantikan subperaturan (1) dengan subperaturan yang berikut:

 "(1) Subject to the terms and conditions as stated in the letter of
appointment, a member of the Council appointed under paragraphs 5(c), (i)
and (j) shall hold the post for a period of not exceeding two years and is eligible
to be reappointed.".

Dibuat 12 September 2022
[SKM.IP(AM)7955 Jilid 2 (58); PN(PU2)527/JLD. 21]

DATO' HAJI ZAZALI BIN HARON
Pengerusi Eksekutif
Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia

Diluluskan

TAN SRI NOH BIN HAJI OMAR
Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi

CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT 1993

CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (THE NATIONAL CO-OPERATIVE
CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 86(2) (m) of the
Co-operative Societies Act 1993 [ Act 502 ], the Commission, with the approval of the
Minister, makes the following regulations:
